| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Notches** `notches` | 0.2 0.1 | Pairs fx fy from -0.5 to 0.5 cycles/px, up to 32 | The notch centers as pairs of fx and fy in cycles per pixel, one per line. Click a peak in the Spectrum panel to add one. |
| **Notch shape** `shape` | Butterworth | Ideal, Butterworth, Gaussian | The shape of each notch, as for the low-pass and high-pass filters. |
| **Notch radius** `radius` | 0.01 | 0.002 to 0.1 cycles/px | The radius D_0 of each notch, in cycles per pixel. |
| **Order** `order` | 2 | 1 to 10 | The order n of Butterworth notches. Other shapes ignore it. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
